note: ZKTeco Devices (SmartPRS 2 → Attendance → ZKTeco Devices). Which rows of the `devices` register this screen lists, where a device pushes its punches, and the steps to configure one. SmartPRS 3 has ONE programmatic surface, /api/v3; a device or its middleware pushes punches there as JSON with a Bearer credential minted on the API Keys screen. Native ADMS (iclock/cdata) is not spoken by the server, so a ZKTeco device reaches it through its push middleware (ZKBioTime / ADMS bridge) or the offline export on Punch Import. Edit the words here, never the PHP.

protocol.label: ADMS / push (HTTP)
protocol.note: Port 4370 is the device's own LAN service (pull mode). ADMS / cloud push goes out from the device on 80 or 443 to the server address below.

steps: On the device: Menu → Comm. → Ethernet — give it a fixed IP, mask and gateway on your LAN (DHCP off).
Menu → Comm. → Cloud Server Setting (ADMS): Enable Domain Name = ON, Server Address = the push URL host shown above, Server Port = 80 (443 with HTTPS on), Proxy = OFF. Save and restart the device.
Menu → System → Date/Time: set the business timezone. Punches are stored as wall-clock instants; a device an hour off is an hour of late marks.
Enrol each employee with the SAME number as the employee record's Device User ID (Employees → edit → device_user_id). A punch whose number matches nobody waits on Pending Punches.
Mint a credential on API Keys (scope attendance.write) and give it to the push middleware together with the push URL. The key is shown once.
Send one test punch and watch this screen: the device's serial appears with its last punch received. Then check Attendance → Daily for the day.
troubleshooting: No punch received: the serial on the device (Menu → System Info → Device Info) must equal the Serial / Device ID on its register row.
Punches on Pending Punches but not on attendance: the employee's device_user_id is blank or different from the enrolment number.
Duplicate uploads are harmless: every upload carries its own Idempotency-Key and a repeat is answered, not re-written.
